research_notes: Identity: PT Midi Utama Indonesia Tbk (established 28 Jun 2007 as PT Midimart Utama; IPO 30 Nov 2010, ticker MIDI) operates the Alfamidi minimarkets, Alfamidi Super supermarkets and Midi Fresh fruit stores (2,587 stores at end-2025: 2,333 own + 170 franchised minimarkets, 79 + 1 supermarkets, 4 fruit stores; FS2025 PDF p. 21). Parent PT Sumber Alfaria Trijaya Tbk (AMRT, 77.09%, 25,775,473,000 shares; FS2025 PDF p. 74); ultimate parent PT Perdana Mulia Fajar. No rename found: FS2019-FS2025 and the 9M2026 FS all use the current name.

Sources: all figures come from the company website alfamidiku.com (Korporasi menu: audited FS "Laporan Keuangan Tahunan", AR, quarterly FS, AGMS resolution summaries, disclosures, management presentations), fetched directly with curl (no bot protection). idx.co.id was not needed. No news or aggregator source used for any value.

Currency/units: IDR reporter; FS in Rp juta (millions), divided by 1,000 to IDR billion. Basis: FY2019-FY2024 are consolidated FS (MIDI + PT Lancar Wiguna Sejahtera, "LWS", the Lawson convenience-store franchisee). FY2025 FS are titled "Laporan Keuangan" (not consolidated) because LWS was sold on 14 May 2025, but they consolidate LWS from 1 Jan to 14 May 2025 (FS2025 Note 25, PDF p. 86: LWS contributed revenue 357,805, operating loss 64,516, and -46,360 to profit attributable). The 9M2026 FS (and the 9M2025 comparative) are the Company's own statements with LWS (Jan-May 2025) shown as "share of loss of subsidiary". basis is set to "consolidated" throughout.

LWS divestment (not a spin-off of MIDI shares): MIDI sold its 70% of LWS to its parent AMRT for Rp200,455 million (affiliated-transaction disclosures of 9 Apr 2025 and 14 May 2025 on alfamidiku.com; deed of sale 14 May 2025). As a common-control transaction the Rp126,123 million difference between the sale price and the LWS carrying amount was charged to additional paid-in capital, not to profit (FS2025 Note 25, PDF p. 86; equity statement PDF p. 18: APIC 1,260,626 -> 1,134,503). FY2024 figures include 12 months of LWS (FY2024 profit attributable 546,407 after a LWS-driven NCI loss of -70,830).

Restatement: FS2022 changed the attribution of employee benefits to periods of service (DSAK IAI press release of Apr 2022 on PSAK 24 / IFRIC agenda decision IAS 19) and restated 2020-2021 (FS2022 Note 2o, PDF p. 54-56): FY2021 profit attributable 275,217 -> 269,687, equity attributable 1,615,794 -> 1,667,111 (31 Dec 2021) and 1,398,186 -> 1,453,621 (31 Dec 2020), total assets 6,344,016 -> 6,329,539 and 5,923,693 -> 5,911,970. This file keeps FY2019-FY2021 AS ORIGINALLY REPORTED (consistent with the FY2020/FY2021 dividends and payout ratios); each affected datum names the restated value. FY2019 was not restated (FS2022 restates only from 1 Jan 2021). FS2024 also re-presents FY2023 operating cash flow (1,310,502 -> 1,315,327, interest received reclassified).

Corporate actions 2019-01-01 to 2026-11-04: (1) 1:10 stock split, ex 6 Mar 2023 (nominal Rp100 -> Rp10); (2) rights issue I (PMHMETD I) 625:100 at Rp270, ex 6 Jul 2023, 4,611,764,800 new shares listed 21 Jul 2023. No other split, reverse split, bonus or rights issue: the AR2025 share-listing chronology (PDF p. 81) lists only the 2010 IPO, the 2023 split and the 2023 rights issue. No rights/bonus issue went ex before 2020-12-31, so fy.2019.year_end_price is not stored. Per-share history: FY2020-FY2022 EPS/shares/prices are printed on the pre-split basis (share_basis before 6 Mar 2023); FY2022 dividend (paid Jun 2023) is on the post-split basis.

Dividends: one final cash dividend per year out of FY2020-FY2025 profit, paid after the AGMS (AR2024 PDF p. 109, AR2025 PDF p. 129 dividend tables; 9M2026 deck PDF p. 26). Payout policy 30% until FY2023, 45% for FY2024, 50% for FY2025. The first interim dividend (Rp3.8/share out of FY2026 profit, ex 12 Nov 2026, paid 1 Dec 2026) was announced on 3 Nov 2026 and is recorded as fy 2026. Dividend totals are the exact rupiah amounts of the AGMS resolutions (FY2022: "maximum Rp119,905,884,800"; FS2023 Note 16 shows 119,906 juta).

EBITDA: taken from each year's own AR highlights (Rp juta); MIDI prints no definition. Reconciliation hint (not stored): FY2025 operating profit 967,994 + fixed-asset depreciation 484,320 (FS2025 PDF p. 53) + right-of-use depreciation 422,437 (PDF p. 69) = 1,874,751 vs reported EBITDA 1,909,700, the rest presumably amortisation of other non-current assets. AR2022 prints a restated 2020 EBITDA of 1,239,279 (ratio 9.79%) that does not match AR2020/AR2021 (1,142,197) or the 2023 deck chart (1,142); the original is stored and the conflict noted. The 9M 2026 materials report EBIT, not EBITDA, so interim EBITDA is null.

Debt: MIDI's interest-bearing debt was bank loans only (BCA money-market/overdraft, Mandiri working-capital, investment loans); all were repaid in 2023-2024 (62,792 left at end-2023, nil since end-2024; facilities of Rp1.5 tn stay undrawn at 30 Sep 2026). total_debt equals the AR line "Pinjaman yang dikenakan bunga" for 2020-2023. Large lease liabilities (store rents, PSAK 73 from 2020) are excluded as the brief requires: 315.7 bn (2020) to 680.8 bn (9M2026).

Cash flow: capex = "Perolehan aset tetap" only. MIDI also pays advances for fixed assets (46.7-138.4 bn a year) that are reclassified into fixed assets later (non-cash), and adds right-of-use assets (prepaid rents, 194.8-370.7 bn); both are listed in each capex note but not added. From FY2024 the cash line is "Kas dan bank" (cash on hand and in banks).

Ratios: roe/roa are as printed in the AR key-ratio tables: profit for the year INCLUDING non-controlling interests divided by YEAR-END total equity / total assets (e.g. FY2025 772,491 / 4,541,893 = 17.01%). They differ from profit-attributable/equity-attributable ratios in FY2023-FY2024 when LWS losses were shared with the 30% NCI.

Year-end prices: Q4 closes from each AR's quarterly share table (AR2020 PDF p. 7, AR2021 p. 8, AR2022 p. 7, AR2023 p. 9, AR2024 p. 10, AR2025 p. 12). The ARs do not print the exact last trading date; as_of_date is set to 31 Dec. AR2022/AR2023 print a Q4-2022 HIGH of 4,890 (Q3 high 2,900, close 2,970) - looks like a spike or typo, not used. AR publication dates (share_basis) are the PDF metadata dates; the ARs carry no printed release date.

Store count / sales mix are not stored. 2026: the 9M 2026 deck (PDF p. 23) reports SSSG +4.2% (Alfamidi, 9M) and notes that from 2026 mobile airtime/data top-ups are booked as fee income, depressing reported revenue growth (+9.2% YoY for 9M).
